patch_description: Replace the fixed concentric-ring layout with a deterministic nonlinear packing refinement initialized from a staggered hexagonal arrangement. The staggered six-row seed has substantially better local density than rings and gives the optimizer a feasible, well-distributed starting point. SLSQP directly maximizes the sum of independently varying radii subject to every border and pairwise non-overlap inequality. Several small deterministic perturbations break artificial symmetry and allow boundary circles and interior layers to adopt unequal radii. An exact final safety scaling makes the returned result valid even if the numerical optimizer stops with tiny constraint tolerance errors.
